app.name: OAF OS
app.tagline: The operating backbone for the mission.
app.description: Intake, member support, care packages, retreats, coaching, resources, and impact visibility.

login.heading: Login to OAF OS
login.subheading: Alpha preview — no real accounts or authentication.
login.intro: This is a demo role picker. No credentials are required. Select a role to explore the app.
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Contact OAF staff.
login.demoPrompt: Exploring OAF OS? Use a demo role below.

rolePicker.heading: Choose a demo role
rolePicker.subheading: This is the OAF OS alpha preview.
rolePicker.intro: Select a role to explore the app from that perspective. No account required. All data shown is fictional and lives only in this browser.

member.label: Member
member.description: View your application status, check-ins, care packages, and resources.

staff.label: Staff
staff.description: Manage intake, review requests, assign tasks, and track care package lifecycles.

coach.label: Coach
coach.description: Review member check-ins, log coaching notes, and manage your task queue.

dashboard.heading: Mission Overview
dashboard.staffGreeting: Good to have you. Here's what needs attention.
dashboard.coachGreeting: Ready when you are. Here's your queue.
dashboard.noticeDemo: You are viewing demo data. Nothing here is a real record.
dashboard.noticeCrisis: If you are in crisis, do not wait. Call or text 988.

applications.heading: Applications
applications.subheading: Apply for support or review submitted applications.
applications.intro: Choose the path that fits your situation. Staff review every submission before any support is granted.

applyForm.heading: Apply for Support
applyForm.intro: Plain language is fine. A staff member reviews every submission before any action is taken.
applyForm.ackNotice: Before submitting, confirm this is not an emergency. For emergencies, call 911 or text 988.
applyForm.localStorageNotice: Anything you enter here is saved only in this browser on this device — not sent to OAF. Anyone with access to this browser can see it. To remove it, reset demo data in Settings.

carePackages.heading: Care Packages
carePackages.subheading: Track requests from submission to follow-up.
carePackages.intro: Every request is reviewed by staff. Priority and eligibility are assessed before approval.

tasks.heading: Tasks
tasks.intro: Tasks are assigned by role. Mark done when complete. Flag blocked if something is in the way.

checkIns.heading: Check-Ins
checkIns.subheading: A quick read on where you are.
checkIns.intro: Log how you're doing. Mood, energy, sleep, and a note. This is for you and your coach — not a clinical form.
checkIns.scaleNote: Rate mood and energy on a scale of 1 (low) to 5 (high).

coaching.heading: Coaching Notes
coaching.intro: Coaching notes are practical — programming adjustments, accountability reminders, and follow-up items. Not a clinical record.

resources.heading: Resources
resources.intro: These links cover training, mental fortitude, mobility, nutrition, benefits, and crisis support. External links open in a new tab.

retreats.heading: Retreats
retreats.subheading: Multi-day programs built around strength and peer connection.
retreats.intro: Spots are limited and reviewed for fit. Submit interest and staff will follow up.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.intro: These figures are illustrative demo data. They show what impact visibility looks like inside OAF OS — not verified program statistics.

sponsor.heading: Sponsor the Mission
sponsor.intro: Sponsor care packages, retreat seats, scholarships, or general program support. Payments are handled by Stripe — card details go directly to Stripe, not to OAF systems.
sponsor.secureNotice: Payments are processed by Stripe. OAF never stores your card details.

crisis.heading: Crisis Resources
crisis.subheading: If you are in crisis, reach out now.
crisis.intro: OAF OS is not a crisis service. These resources are free, confidential, and available around the clock. Do not wait.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.localStorageNotice: Data you enter is saved on this device only, in your browser's local storage. Anyone with access to this browser can see it. It is never sent to OAF servers in this demo.
settings.clearDataLabel: To remove all stored data, use Reset demo data above.

applications.heading: No applications yet.
applications.body: Start by choosing a support path. Staff review every submission — apply when you're ready.

carePackages.heading: No care package requests.
carePackages.body: If you need equipment or practical support, submit a request. Staff will review eligibility and follow up.

tasks.heading: Your queue is clear.
tasks.body: No tasks assigned right now. Check back after new applications or requests come in.

checkIns.heading: No check-ins logged yet.
checkIns.body: Log your first check-in. It takes under a minute and helps your coach keep up with your momentum.

coaching.heading: No coaching notes yet.
coaching.body: Notes will appear here once your coach begins follow-up. If you expected a note, reach out to your assigned coach.

resources.heading: No resources in this category.
resources.body: Try a different filter, or browse all resources to find what you need.

retreats.heading: No retreat windows open right now.
retreats.body: Retreat dates are added when a new program is confirmed. Check back or submit your interest so staff can notify you.

impact.heading: No impact data available.
impact.body: Impact figures will appear here as the program runs. Check back later.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again or reload the app.
errors.formValidation: Please check the fields below and correct any errors before submitting.
errors.ackRequired: You must acknowledge this before continuing.
errors.submitFailed: Your submission did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: That page or record doesn't exist.
errors.unauthorized: You don't have access to this. Return to the role picker to choose a different role.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Return to the role picker to continue.

offline.heading: You're offline.
offline.body: OAF OS works offline for most features. Some actions — like submitting forms — require a connection. Your data is saved in this browser.

install.heading: Add OAF OS to your home screen
install.body: Install OAF OS for faster access and offline support.

success.applicationSubmitted: This is demo data — your submission was saved in this browser only and was not sent to OAF. If you need help now, call or text 988 (Veterans Crisis Line: call 988 then press 1).
success.carePackageSubmitted: This is demo data — your request was saved in this browser only and was not sent to OAF. If you need support now, call or text 988.
success.retreatInterestSubmitted: This is demo data — your interest was saved in this browser only and was not sent to OAF.

failure.applicationSubmitted: Submission failed. Check your connection and try again.
failure.carePackageSubmitted: Request didn't go through. Try again or contact OAF staff directly.
failure.checkInSaved: Couldn't save your check-in. Try again.
failure.retreatInterestSubmitted: Submission failed. Try again or contact OAF staff directly.

demo.notice: You are viewing demo data. Nothing here is a real record.
demo.resetBody: This will clear all demo data in this browser and reload the default seed. Your real OAF account is not affected.
demo.rolePickerBody: Select a role to explore the app. No account required. All data is fictional and stored only in this browser.
demo.sharedDeviceNotice: Shared device? Data you enter is stored unencrypted in this browser and is visible to anyone who uses it. Use Reset demo data to clear it.

mission.headline: A New Mission To Strengthen Our Veterans & First Responders
mission.noShortcutsDetail: No emergency promises. No clinical claims. Just disciplined operational follow-through for veterans and first responders.

steps.label: You are connected to the right path
Staff and coaches keep follow-up moving

mission.visibilityNote: OAF OS keeps the process visible without exposing private member details to the wrong audience.
